metrics.label: People who exit homelessness
metrics.definition: Unique people with a success from the streets downtown, an encampment or a shelter. A person counts one time.

metrics.label: Goal
metrics.definition: The goal for successes by 12/31/2026.

metrics.label: Progress to the goal
metrics.definition: People who exit homelessness, divided by the goal.

metrics.label: Returned to homelessness within 12 months after a success
metrics.definition: People with a return in the 12 months after their success, divided by all people who exit homelessness.

metrics.label: People who returned
metrics.definition: People with a return in the 12 months after their success.

metrics.label: Durability benchmark
metrics.definition: The share returned must be less than this.

metrics.label: Encampments closed
metrics.definition: Typed on the page.

metrics.label: With maintenance plans
metrics.definition: Typed on the page.

metrics.label: Encampments that remain closed
metrics.definition: Typed on the page.

metrics.label: Remained closed
metrics.definition: Encampments that remain closed, divided by encampments closed.

metrics.label: Tons of garbage cleared
metrics.definition: Typed on the page.

metrics.label: From streets/downtown
metrics.definition: People with an outreach success from Safe Move Tulsa Outreach in the streets downtown (the IDL and The Collar).

metrics.label: From streets/downtown: Subsidy + stabilization
metrics.definition: People with no Safe Move Rapid Exit beside the outreach exit, divided by the people in the box.

metrics.label: From streets/downtown: Rapid exit
metrics.definition: People with a Safe Move Rapid Exit beside the outreach exit, divided by the people in the box.

metrics.label: From encampments
metrics.definition: People with an outreach success from Safe Move Tulsa Outreach at an encampment elsewhere.

metrics.label: From encampments: Subsidy + stabilization
metrics.definition: People with no Safe Move Rapid Exit beside the outreach exit, divided by the people in the box.

metrics.label: From encampments: Rapid exit
metrics.definition: People with a Safe Move Rapid Exit beside the outreach exit, divided by the people in the box.

metrics.label: From shelter
metrics.definition: People whose last emergency shelter exit is a success: from a Tulsa Day Center ES (not HCHV), a Salvation Army ES, a John 3:16 ES or the CREOKS winter shelter, to a listed destination.

metrics.label: From shelter: Subsidy + stabilization
metrics.definition: People who moved in, on or after the shelter exit, at an RRH project whose name ends SMT Shelter to Housing, divided by the shelter successes.

metrics.label: From shelter: Rapid exit
metrics.definition: The other shelter successes, divided by the shelter successes.

metrics.label: Rapid exits from shelter
metrics.definition: Shelter successes with no SMT Shelter to Housing move-in.

metrics.label: Rapid exits from shelter
metrics.definition: Rapid exits from shelter, divided by the shelter successes.

metrics.label: Rapid exits from shelter: Shared housing
metrics.definition: A 1 in the sharedhousing column of the enrollments file.

metrics.label: Rapid exits from shelter: Return to family/friends
metrics.definition: Not shared housing, and an exit to family or friends.

metrics.label: Rapid exits from shelter: Independent housing
metrics.definition: All other rapid exits from shelter.

metrics.label: All SMT exits: returning
metrics.definition: People in this group with a return in the 12 months after their success, divided by the group.

metrics.label: All SMT exits: not returning
metrics.definition: The rest of the group.

metrics.label: All SMT exits: benchmark
metrics.definition: The share returning must be less than this.

metrics.label: Subsidy + stabilization exits: returning
metrics.definition: People in this group with a return in the 12 months after their success, divided by the group.

metrics.label: Subsidy + stabilization exits: not returning
metrics.definition: The rest of the group.

metrics.label: Subsidy + stabilization exits: benchmark
metrics.definition: The share returning must be less than this.

metrics.label: Rapid exits: returning
metrics.definition: People in this group with a return in the 12 months after their success, divided by the group.

metrics.label: Rapid exits: not returning
metrics.definition: The rest of the group.

metrics.label: Rapid exits: benchmark
metrics.definition: The share returning must be less than this.
